system_boundaries.national: The Australian Commission on Safety and Quality in Health Care owns national standards, accreditation guidance and national frameworks; this registry is a versioned mapping, not an authority source.
system_boundaries.AU-NSW: ims+ or another NSW Health-approved incident system remains authoritative for incident notification and status; the Policy Distribution System remains authoritative for statewide policy documents.
system_boundaries.AU-QLD: Queensland Health RiskMan and approved Hospital and Health Service systems remain authoritative; this pack does not submit, update or close incidents or coronial responses.

rules.statement: Maintain organisation-wide incident management and investigation systems that support reporting, consumer participation, learning and risk management.

workflow.authority_boundary: The organisation's approved incident system remains authoritative.
workflow.exception_path: Record unavailable capability and escalate; do not create a shadow notification.

rules.statement: Use an open disclosure programme consistent with the current Australian Open Disclosure Framework and monitor its effectiveness.

workflow.authority_boundary: State and local policy controls timing and accountable roles.
workflow.exception_path: Preserve patient preferences, accessibility and cultural-safety needs; escalate unresolved authority.

rules.statement: Embed Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander cultural safety, partnership and self-determination in governance, participation and communication.

workflow.authority_boundary: Cultural safety is determined by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people; an automated prompt cannot certify it.
workflow.exception_path: Seek appropriately authorised cultural leadership and record unmet consultation needs.

rules.statement: Notify identified incidents in ims+ in accordance with the active Incident Management policy.

workflow.deadline: as soon as practicable under PD2020_047
workflow.authority_boundary: Only verified ims+ state proves notification.
workflow.exception_path: Use the approved local downtime or escalation process; do not mark externally notified from a local record.

rules.uncertainty: PD2020_047 is under review; retain current active-policy behaviour pending authoritative replacement.

rules.statement: Use an approved serious adverse event review method where PD2020_047 requires a serious adverse event review.

workflow.authority_boundary: An accountable NSW Health officer selects and authorises the review path.
workflow.exception_path: Expose uncertainty and escalate; do not infer reportability, review method or statutory privilege.

rules.uncertainty: The pack does not encode a privilege conclusion.

rules.statement: Undertake clinician disclosure within 24 hours of incident identification when the Open Disclosure policy applies.

workflow.authority_boundary: A trained accountable clinician owns disclosure; the workbench records evidence only. Triage must enter review before this canonical consultation event.
workflow.exception_path: Escalate delayed or unsafe disclosure and record patient preferences and support needs.

rules.statement: Govern recommendations and actions through clinical-governance and enterprise-risk systems and review effectiveness rather than equating completion with improvement.

workflow.authority_boundary: The authorised governance body accepts residual risk and effectiveness evidence.
workflow.exception_path: Keep the action open or escalate when effectiveness or residual-risk evidence is inadequate.

rules.statement: Report severity assessment code 1 clinical incidents to Patient Safety and Quality through RiskMan within one business day of awareness.

workflow.authority_boundary: Only verified RiskMan state proves reporting.
workflow.exception_path: Escalate through the approved Hospital and Health Service process; do not infer external submission.

rules.statement: Conduct and submit the analysis of a severity assessment code 1 incident within 90 calendar days of reporting.

workflow.authority_boundary: The Hospital and Health Service owns analysis method, approval and submission.
workflow.exception_path: Record the delay reason and anticipated completion date through the authorised process.

rules.statement: Include the patient, family or carer perspective and consumer representation in incident analysis and recommendation development.

workflow.authority_boundary: Participation follows patient preference, accessibility, cultural safety and authorised local processes.
workflow.exception_path: Record declined, unavailable or unsafe participation without treating silence as agreement.

rules.statement: Submit an initial Hospital and Health Service response to a coronial recommendation to Patient Safety and Quality within 90 days of the inquest findings and provide six-monthly updates until implementation is complete.

workflow.authority_boundary: Authorised legal and governance officers interpret the particular finding and approve the response.
workflow.exception_path: Escalate case-specific uncertainty; do not generalise a finding into a rule or claim legal compliance.

rules.statement: Close a review only after authorised decisions, action evidence, effectiveness review, unresolved uncertainty and residual risk are visible.

workflow.authority_boundary: An accountable human and the external system of record control closure.
workflow.exception_path: Remain in action or effectiveness review, or reopen when evidence is incomplete or new evidence emerges.
